tasks.transcript: Welcome to Hartley Community Centre. I'll give you a quick overview of what we offer. Our main hall is used for fitness classes throughout the week, including yoga on Tuesdays and Thursdays. The centre also has a smaller room for arts and crafts sessions, which run every Saturday morning. Please note that the swimming pool we used to have has been closed permanently due to renovation costs, so unfortunately that facility is no longer available. Membership costs $30 a month and includes access to all classes except the pottery workshop, which requires an additional $10 materials fee.

tasks.transcript: Good morning, and thank you for joining today's orientation tour of Millbrook Botanical Gardens. The gardens are divided into four main sections: the Rose Garden, the Tropical Greenhouse, the Herb Garden, and the newly opened Sculpture Trail. The Tropical Greenhouse is currently closed to the public on weekdays for maintenance but remains open on weekends. If you're interested in guided tours, they depart from the main entrance every hour, though the last tour of the day leaves at 4 p.m., not 5 p.m. as listed in our old brochures. The gift shop, located near the exit, closes thirty minutes after the gardens do.
